capabilities.meaning: Both cargo and rustc are available for Rust source gates.
A codefire command is available on PATH; this does not bind it to current source.
A Codex CLI is available on PATH.
Git is available and the repository can be inspected.
A local CodeFire Rust binary exists; it is smoke-only without source binding.
Post-build evidence binds a Rust binary to the source input manifest; absence must block approval, not task startup.
The timeout command is available for bounded smoke tests.
